name: tr_dray
caption:
IF DRAYMOND WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

💪 Machop, the second-rounder: 34 players went before him, we took him at #35
🧱 Shuckle, the wall: 2017 Defensive Player of the Year, and the steals leader
🧠 Metagross, the brain: 7.8 assists a night through 8 games
🐒 Primeape, the hothead: 16 technicals in one season
❤️ Conkeldurr, the heart and soul: 4 rings, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022
🏋️ Machamp, the ace: 36 years old, started all 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Green: drafted 35th overall (2nd round) in 2012 by Golden State, 34 players before him; 2017 Defensive Player of the Year and NBA steals leader (2017); March 16, 2023: suspended for his 16th technical foul of the season; emotional heart and soul of the Warriors, noted for vocal leadership; 4x NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022); born March 4, 1990 (age 36)
